title: Space Agents
description:
## Space Agents v2: Beads-First Architecture

Epic for transitioning Space Agents to Beads-first workflow:
- All execution state in Beads (features, tasks, bugs, comments)
- Comments as handovers with titled prefixes for parsing
- Exploration folder as thinking space (drafts → ready → Beads)
- CAPCOM as session log

## Features
1. **Execution Flow Skills** - Update /pod, /airlock, /capcom, /handover for Model B
2. **Agent Prompts and Terminology** - Update 9 agent prompts with Beads terminology
3. **Exploration & Planning Workflow** - Implement exploration kanban and /planning skill

title: Execution Flow Skills
description:
## Goal
Update /pod, /airlock, /capcom, and /handover for Beads-first execution. Pod self-fetches work (Model B), handovers are Beads comments, no mission folders.

## Key Architecture Changes
- **Model B**: Pod queries bd ready to pick work, fetches own context from dependency comments
- **Comments as Work Log**: Task comments track full work history with titled prefixes ([ATTEMPT], [PROGRESS], [BLOCKED], [HANDOVER], [CONTEXT])
- **No Mission Folders**: Everything lives in Beads (features, tasks, comments)

## Success Criteria
- Pod uses Model B (self-fetch, comment handovers)
- Comments use titled format for parsing
- Airlock creates blocking bugs with [CONTEXT] comment
- CAPCOM shows accurate Beads status with work log
- Session handover generates from Beads
- No SQLite or mission folder references
close_reason: All 4 execution flow skills updated for Beads-first workflow: pod (Model B), airlock (blocking bugs), capcom (Beads queries), handover (session context)

title: Update /pod for Model B with Beads comments
description:
**File:** skills/pod/skill.md

## Changes
Rewrite for Model B: Pod self-fetches work and uses comment-based handovers.

### Model B Flow
1. Query bd ready -t task to pick work
2. Claim task via bd update --status in_progress
3. Get task details via bd show
4. Get parent feature for mission requirements
5. Get dependency handovers via bd comments (filter by [HANDOVER])
6. Work on task, log progress with titled comments
7. Write [HANDOVER] comment before closing
8. If blocked, write [BLOCKED] comment and create bug

### Remove
- All folder path references (missions/active/, handovers/)
- Signal file creation (.done, .failed)
- SQLite queries

## Verification
- Pod queries bd ready -t task
- Pod reads parent feature description
- Pod writes titled comments
- No SQLite or folder references
close_reason: Pod updated for Model B with Beads comments. Added [ATTEMPT] prefix.

title: Update /airlock to create blocking bugs
description:
**File:** skills/airlock/SKILL.md

## Changes
Airlock creates bugs that block tasks, with context for the fixer.

### Bug Creation Flow
1. On validation failure, create bug via bd create -t bug
2. Add [CONTEXT] comment with failure details (task blocked, failure type, test output, suggested fix)
3. Block task via bd dep add
4. bd sync

### Severity Mapping
| Failure | Severity | Blocks? |
|---------|----------|---------|
| Tests fail | severity:blocker | Yes |
| Lint fail | severity:warning | No |
| Build fail | severity:critical | Yes + halts Ralph |

## Verification
- Airlock creates bug with bd create -t bug
- Bug has [CONTEXT] comment
- Bug blocks task via bd dep add
- [ALERT:] changed to [BUG:]
close_reason: Airlock updated to create blocking bugs with [CONTEXT] comments and severity mapping

title: Update /handover for session context
description:
**File:** skills/handover/skill.md

## Changes
Generate session handover from Beads state.

### Session vs Task Handovers
| Type | Purpose | Storage |
|------|---------|---------|
| Task handover | Context for next task | bd comments on task |
| Session handover | Context for next human session | comms/handover.md |

### Session Handover Content
- Dependency tree (bd list --tree)
- Next ready tasks (bd ready -t task)
- In progress tasks with recent [PROGRESS]/[ATTEMPT] comments
- Open bugs
- Completed task [HANDOVER] comments

## Verification
- Handover captures Beads state
- bd list --tree included
- Recent task comments included (filtered by title)
- Saved to .space-agents/comms/handover.md

title: Exploration & Planning Workflow
description:
## Goal
Implement exploration folder as scratchpad/kanban for ideas and draft plans. Separate thinking space (exploration) from doing space (Beads). CAPCOM becomes mission/session log.

## Architecture
- exploration/drafts/ - Brainstorming, early ideas (kanban: backlog)
- exploration/ready/ - Approved plans ready to convert to Beads
- Beads - Execution-ready work items (features, tasks, bugs)
- CAPCOM (comms/capcom.md) - Session log with mission start/end entries

## Workflow
1. /exploration → Brainstorm in drafts/{topic}/
2. /planning → Review drafts, move to ready/, convert to Beads
3. /launch → Log mission start to CAPCOM
4. /mission → Execute from Beads
5. /dock → Log mission end to CAPCOM

## Success Criteria
- Exploration folder has drafts/ready kanban
- /exploration writes to drafts/
- /planning manages kanban and Beads conversion
- CAPCOM logs mission start/end
- Old missions/ folder archived

title: Create exploration folder structure
description:
## Goal
Set up the exploration kanban folder structure.

## Folder Structure
```
.space-agents/
├── exploration/
│   ├── drafts/              # Ideas and draft plans (kanban: backlog)
│   │   └── {topic-slug}/
│   │       ├── exploration.md
│   │       └── draft-plan.md
│   └── ready/               # Approved plans (kanban: ready)
│       └── {topic-slug}/
│           └── plan.md
├── comms/
│   ├── capcom.md            # Session log
│   └── handover.md          # Session handover
└── .beads/                  # Execution (source of truth)
```

## Implementation
Update /install skill to create this structure:
```bash
mkdir -p .space-agents/exploration/{drafts,ready}
mkdir -p .space-agents/comms
```

## Verification
- exploration/drafts/ and exploration/ready/ exist after install
- Old missions/staged/active/complete/ structure not created

title: Update /exploration skill for drafts workflow
description:
**File:** skills/exploration/skill.md

## Current Behavior
Creates exploration/YYYY-MM-DD-{topic}/exploration.md

## New Behavior
- Creates exploration/drafts/{topic-slug}/
- Writes exploration.md (brainstorm notes)
- Optionally writes draft-plan.md (if plan emerges)
- Offers to move to ready/ when exploration is complete

## Output Templates
exploration.md: Context, Key Decisions table, Architecture, Next Steps
draft-plan.md: Goal, Tasks list, Key Files, Dependencies

## Verification

- exploration.md follows template
- Optional draft-plan.md when plan emerges
- Offers 'move to ready' at end

title: Create /planning skill
description:
**File:** skills/planning/skill.md (NEW)

## Goal
New skill to manage the planning kanban and Beads conversion.

## /planning Menu
- Show drafts (exploration/drafts/)
- Show ready (exploration/ready/)
- Actions: Move draft to ready, Convert ready to Beads, Delete draft, View details

## Move to Ready
mv exploration/drafts/{topic} exploration/ready/{topic}

## Convert to Beads
1. Read plan from ready folder
2. Create feature via bd create -t feature --parent $EPIC_ID
3. Create tasks from plan via bd create -t task --parent $FEATURE_ID
4. Set up dependencies via bd dep add
5. Archive plan to exploration/archive/{topic}
6. bd sync

## Verification
- /planning shows drafts and ready items
- Can move drafts to ready
- Can convert ready plans to Beads
- Converted plans archived

title: Update CAPCOM for session logging
description:
**Files:** skills/capcom/skill.md, skills/launch/skill.md, skills/dock/skill.md

## Goal
CAPCOM becomes the mission log with structured session entries.

## Mission = Session
A 'mission' is a session container, logged in CAPCOM:

### /launch adds:
```
## [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] Mission Start
**ID:** MSN-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN
**Target:** {feature_id}
**Goal:** {goal}
```

### /dock adds:
```
## [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] Mission End
**ID:** MSN-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN
**Duration:** Xh Ym
### Completed (tasks)
### Handovers (from [HANDOVER] comments)
### In Progress
### Blockers (from [BLOCKED] comments)
### Created (bugs)
### Next Session
```

## Verification
- /launch logs mission start to CAPCOM
- /dock logs mission end with summary including titled comments
- Mission IDs sequential per day

title: Archive old missions/ folder
description:
## Goal
Clean up legacy folder structure, preserve history.

## Migration Steps
```bash
# 1. Archive completed missions
if [ -d ".space-agents/missions/complete" ]; then
    mkdir -p .space-agents/archive
    mv .space-agents/missions/complete .space-agents/archive/missions-complete
fi

# 2. Archive staged folder
if [ -d ".space-agents/missions/staged" ]; then
    mv .space-agents/missions/staged .space-agents/archive/missions-staged
fi

# 3. Remove empty missions directory
rmdir .space-agents/missions 2>/dev/null || true

# 4. Update .gitignore
echo ".space-agents/archive/" >> .gitignore
```

## Verification
- missions/complete/ archived to archive/missions-complete/
- missions/staged/ archived to archive/missions-staged/
- No missions/ folder in active structure
- Archive gitignored
